title: dark mode: dashboard chart axis tick labels use recharts' default #666 (~3:1 on the dark card)
body:
Filing gate: **① a user-visible UX defect with a named landing point and a reproduction** (`pm:queue` class).
Reader: the objectui lane owning `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — the fix PR there.
Dedupe (open AND closed, semantic search on objectstack-ai/objectui): "chart axis tick label color dark mode contrast #666" → 4 hits (#12375, #11681, #7386, #8246); none covers this item.

reach: measured in the console UX walkthrough — stock showcase with `--seed-admin`, framework objectstack-ai/objectstack@54159fd742e5, console pin objectui@12dc7b47c340 (dist stamp equal to the pin), Chromium at 1440x900; re-checked against objectui main source at df943a2a1af3 when found and ed28057 when split (the cited files are unchanged between the two).
type: Bug

Split out of #13115 (item 8), which folded fifteen independent defects into one card under the per-fire filing quota, which the maintainer has since ruled does not bind a concentrated test run such as a walkthrough. Split by the 18.0 QA wave dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi`, on the maintainer's instruction there, verbatim: 「#13115 你可以拆」.

## Where

Any dashboard (Showcase → Analytics → Delivery Operations) with the OS in dark mode.

## Actual

Axis tick text has a computed fill of #666 on the dark card, about 3:1, under the 4.5:1 needed for 12 px text; the category labels (Green / Yellow / Red, Backlog / To Do …) are the hard ones to read.

## Expected

Ticks use the theme's muted-foreground, as the simple chart already does.

## Source

`packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — `XAxis` / `YAxis` pass no `tick` fill, so recharts' default #666 applies; `packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartImpl.tsx` sets `fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))'`.
